identitySignals: Name matches a Mad Science franchise listed as 'Mad Science of Mt. Diablo' in Concord, CA, matching the agenda text (Chatterblock directory)
Listing says it runs in-class workshops and after-school science programs in Contra Costa and Alameda Counties, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' category
research.notes: Only third-party directory listings found. The franchise website (mtdiablo.madscience.org) now redirects to a page-not-found, so no official site was confirmed. Directories disagree on the street address (1341 Galaxy Way vs 1150 Burnett Ave, both Concord), so address omitted. No registry (CA SOS, SAM.gov) record checked or found, and no source tying it explicitly to Oakland schools. Legal entity name unknown.

profile.summary: Mad Science of Mt. Diablo is a locally operated franchise of Mad Science. It runs hands-on science workshops, after-school programs and special events for children in Contra Costa and Alameda Counties.
